Like 350, this class had tangible effects on me and my plans. I was waiting for this course and feel happy that I can take it in my 4th year. Taking the Theory of Mind class may look frightening to some people since it is a graduate course at the same time. Still, I strongly recommend it to those passionate about developmental psychology. Everyone majoring in psychology should have advanced knowledge about the Theory of Mind since it applies to any field and particular aspects of human life. I wish every psychologist knew more about TOM because I KNOW that this knowledge will bring more and more to their specialization. It is essential for clinical cases, psychology in educational settings, psychology in a broad sense as social psychology, etc... Personally, from my early childhood, I valued empathy and perspective taking all the time. I am a person who can understand anyone and want to help everyone (altruistically), and I was there for all the kids who had been bullied. This perspective-taking brings me anxiety in some aspects, too. So, TOM is crucial for cognitive development, but it should have a place in schools, education specialists also know about TOM, and school policies should be changed accordingly. I can see the clear connections between TOM and its practical applications. I wish that the course had more just than social-cognitive research subjects. For example, we can talk about the practical applications that can draw from the research results presented during the lectures.
